source: 738 Original Arrangement
target: 738 Dispositio Originalis

source: Magician concurred tersely.
target: Magus breviter assentivit.

source: “No problem.
target: “Nulla quaestio.

source: I understand the urgency.
target: Intellego urgentiam.

source: I’ll bring you there once Mr. Hanged Man and I confirm the time.”
target: Te illuc ducam, cum Dominus Suspenditus et ego tempus confirmaverimus.

source: Lumian fell silent for a moment before saying, “Thank you.”
target: Lumian paulisper tacuit, deinde dixit: “Gratias.”

source: Madam Magician pondered for a moment and reminded him, “But don’t be too hasty.
target: Magistra Magica paulisper meditata est et eum admonuit: “Sed noli nimis festinare.

source: Emperor Roselle once said, ‘More haste, less speed.’
target: Imperator Roselle olim dixit: ‘Plus festinatio, minus velocitas.’

source: “It’s not just because impatience blinds you and affects your judgment, causing you to make wrong choices in many matters.
target: “Non solum quod impatiens te caecat et iudicium tuum afficit, faciens ut in multis rebus decisiones falsas capias.

source: It’s also because consuming the potion to advance has a requirement on your mental state.
target: Etiam quod potionem ad progressum sumere statum animi tui exigit.

source: You should be well aware of this.”
target: Hoc bene scire debes.”

source: “I understand,” Lumian said with a sigh.
target: “Intellego,” inquit Lumian cum suspirio.

source: Madam Magician glanced around and joked, “You were really tense just now.
target: Magistra Magica circumspiciens iocata est: “Nuper vere anxius eras.

source: We’ve been talking this whole time, but you didn’t even remember to invite me to sit down.
target: Totum hoc tempore locuti sumus, sed ne mihi quidem meministi ut me ad sedendum invitarem.

source: “Yes, the School of Truth’s vortex clearly involves higher-level forces.
target: “Ita, vortex Scholae Veritatis clare vires superiores implicat.

source: We’ll take over the subsequent investigations.
target: Inquisitiones posteriores nos suscipiemus.

source: Your primary mission is to locate the relatively important Mirror People according to what Moran Avigny had shared.
target: Missio primaria tua est reperire Populum Specularum, qui relative magni momenti sunt, secundum ea quae Moran Avigny narraverat.

source: I suspect that something in the special mirror world is an important part of the vortex.
target: Suspicor aliquid in mundo speculari speciali esse partem praecipue momenti vorticis.

source: “This time, you’ve obtained crucial information.
target: “Hoc tempore, notitiae maximi momenti adeptus es.

source: We Major Arcana card holders won’t be stingy with the rewards.
target: Nos, qui cartas Major Arcana habemus, non erimus parcitrici cum praemiis.

source: Of course, it’s for your team, not just you.
target: Scilicet, pro turma tua est, non solum tibi.

source: The exact distribution is up to you.”
target: Distributio exacta tibi delegatur.”

source: Upon hearing the last sentence, Lumian suddenly fell into a daze.
target: Audito ultimo verbo, Lumian subito in torporis statum incidit.

source: He muttered to himself, “Again…
target: Sibi murmurat: “Iterum…

source: “Is this also what fate has bestowed?”
target: Numquid hoc etiam est quod fata largita sint?

source: “I can’t say for sure that’s not the case,” Madam Magician replied with a self-deprecating smile.
target: “Non possum certo dicere id non esse,” inquit Magistra Magica cum risu modesto.

source: “Your psychological and mental state are better than I expected.
target: Status mentis et animi tui melius sunt quam exspectavi.

source: You haven’t reached the point where you need treatment again, but you seem to have suffered from the aftereffects of the trauma known as Fate’s Bestowment.
target: Non attigisti gradum, ubi denuo curationem requiras, sed videtur te passum esse ab effectibus post traumaticos, qui Fati Largitio vocatur.

source: Everything you see seems arranged as if by fate’s hand.”
target: Omnia quae vides ita ordinantur quasi manu fati.”

source: Without waiting for Lumian’s response, she added, “Actually, there’s no problem with that.
target: Non exspectans responsum Lumiani, addidit: “Revera, in hoc nullum est problema.

source: It’s good to be vigilant, but don’t put too much pressure on yourself.
target: Bonum est vigilare, sed noli te nimis oneri subicere.

source: Your mind is like an eraser.
target: Mens tua est instar cancellatoris, qui notis tollit.

source: If you’re too tense, it’ll snap.
target: Si nimis tensus eris, rumpetur.

source: You can be vigilant about details, but you have to relax.
target: Potes in rebus subtilibus vigilare, sed oportet te relaxare.

source: Think about it.
target: Cogita de hoc.

source: You can’t resist a real arrangement anyway.
target: In veram dispositionem resistere non potes.

source: Why make yourself unable to sleep well, eat well, and become more and more neurotic?”
target: Cur te ipsum efficis ut bene dormias, bene edas, atque magis ac magis anxius fies?

source: “Yes.” Lumian had to admit that Madam Magician had a point.
target: “Ita,” Lumian agnoscere debuit quod Magistra Magica recte dixit.

source: Magician expressed satisfaction at Lumian’s ability to self-regulate.
target: Magistra Magica satisfactionem expressit de facultate Lumiani ad sui ipsius temperandum.

source: “Of course, once you discover any arrangements that are clearly problematic, remember to inform me immediately by reciting the honorific name.
target: “Scilicet, cum quasquam dispositiones, quae manifeste problematicae videntur, reperies, memento me statim certiorem facere recitando nomen honorificum.

source: “For the reward this time, I’ll include the Sequence 4 potion formula of the Hunter pathway, facilitating your quest for items on the Blue Avenger.
target: “Pro praemio hoc tempore includam formulam poculi Sequenciae 4 viae Venatoris, quae tuam inquisitionem rerum in Blue Avenger faciliorem reddet.

source: As for the rewards for the Two of Cups, Seven of Cups, and Four of Swords, I don’t know either.
target: Quod attinet ad praemia pro Duobus Poculis, Septem Poculis, et Quattuor Gladiis, neque scio.

source: It mainly depends on what Judgment, The Hermit, and the others will offer.”
target: Praecipue pendet a iis quae Iudicium, Eremita, aliique offerent.

source: Lumian had no objections to this arrangement.
target: Lumian huic dispositioni nullas objectiones habuit.

source: Even if Madam Magician didn’t mention it or believed that the information about the vortex and the Mirror People wasn’t worth the demigod-level potion formula, he would take the initiative to request that the other party provide it first before making up for the missing contributions.
target: Etiam si Magistra Magica id non memoravisset aut credidisset notitiam de vortice atque Populo Specularum formulae poculi demidei deo dignae non esse, ille inceptivus esset rogandi ut pars altera id prius praebeat, antequam contributiones defuntas compensaret.

source: As Lumian regained his composure, a question crossed his mind.
target: Dum Lumian compositum animi recuperabat, quaestio illi occurrit.

source: “Madam, Mr. K of the Aurora Order has already divulged my contributions in front of the True Creator’s idol, requesting Him to put me up as a candidate Oracle.
target: “Domina, Dominus K Ordinis Aurorae iam meas contributiones coram idolum Vero Creatoris divulgavit, petens ut me pro candidato Oraculo proponat.

source: When an official Oracle falls into danger, I will become the prime candidate to replace them.
target: Cum Oraculus officialis in periculum incidat, primus candidatus supplere eos ero.

source: When the time comes, will I truly become a certain Mr. of the Aurora Order?
target: Quando tempus adveniet, vere num fiet ut aliquis Dominus Ordinis Aurorae sim?

source: “In addition, Mr. K also promised material rewards in the next few days.”
target: “Praeterea, Dominus K etiam praemia materialia in diebus proximis promisit.”

source: Magician nodded slightly and said, “The Aurora Order’s organizational structure is quite peculiar.
target: Magistra Magica leviter annuit et dixit: “Structura Ordinis Aurorae valde peculiaris est.

source: Although Oracles have a Saint directly above them, most Oracles can directly hear the ravings of that entity and His instructions, giving them strong autonomy.
target: Quamquam Oraculi Sanctum directe super se habent, plerique Oraculi verba illius atque praecepta eius directe audire possunt, quod eis magnam autonomiam tribuit.

source: Yes, they still follow the orders of their Saint superiors and report to them on most matters, but there are a few matters that completely bypass their superiors.
target: Ita, praecepta Sancti superiorum eorum sequuntur et de plurimis rebus ad eos referunt, sed quaedam sunt quae penitus superiores praetereunt.

source: Recommending a candidate Oracle is one of them.
target: Candidatum Oraculum commendare unum ex his est.

source: “An oracle of God can only come from God’s revelation.”
target: “Oraculus Dei solum ex revelatione Dei provenire potest.”

source: After a brief sigh, Magician chuckled and said, “As long as there’s no major problem with the screening, feel free to accept the material rewards.
target: Post brevem suspirum, Magistra Magica risit et dixit: “Dum in probatione nulla maior difficultas sit, libenter accipe praemia materialia.

source: You’ve already received enough of fate’s bestowments.
target: Iamdudum satis largitionum fatrae accepisti.

source: Any more and there won’t be any substantial changes.
target: Quidquid amplius, nullae substantiales mutationes erunt.

source: “I don’t think being an Oracle will happen.
target: “Non puto futurum esse ut Oraculus fias.

source: The Aurora Order’s Oracles have a fixed preaching area.
target: Oraculi Ordinis Aurorae aream praedicandi fixam habent.

source: It can’t beat letting you run around and trigger various hidden dangers of evil gods.
target: Non potest competere cum te sinere circum vagari et varia occultata pericula diorum malorum excitare.

source: It will help you digest the potion.
target: Adiuvabit te potionem digere.

source: Uh…”
target: Heu…

source: At this point, Magician’s expression gradually turned odd.
target: Ad hoc puncto, vultus Magistrae Magicae paulatim insolutus factus est.

source: Lumian wasn’t in a hurry to inquire.
target: Lumian non festinabat interrogare.

source: He waited for the Major Arcana card holder to take the initiative to explain.
target: Exspectabat ut possessor cartarum Major Arcana inceptum caperet ad explanandum.

source: After a few seconds, Magician maintained her expression and hesitantly said, “Perhaps, that person’s original arrangement was for you to be a certain Mr. for a while.
target: Post paucis secundis, Magistra Magica vultum suum retinuit et titubanter dixit: “Forsitan, dispositio originalis illius fuit ut aliquantisper esses aliquis Dominus.

source: “The Hunter pathway’s Sequence 4 is known as Iron-blooded Knight.
target: “Sequencia 4 viae Venatoris nota est ut Eques Sanguineo Ferreo.

source: It makes all consumers transform into men.
target: Omnes consumptores in viros transformare facit.

source: Its ritual requires the formation of a team of at least 30 people.
target: Ritual eius formationem turmae ex saltem triginta hominibus requirit.

source: They should be able to comprehend your intentions based on your gaze and actions after long periods of nurturing—as though all of you are nearly one.
target: Illi tua consilia ex aspectu et actionibus post longam institutionem intellegere debent, quasi omnes vobis fere unum essetis.

source: The higher the team’s strength and tacit understanding, the better the effect of the ritual.”
target: Quo altius vis turmae et tacita intellectio, eo melius effectus ritualis.

source: Think about it.
target: Cogita de hoc.

source: What’s the most striking characteristic of the Aurora Order?
target: Quae est notabilissima proprietas Ordinis Aurorae?

source: It’s fanaticism.
target: Est fanaticismus.

source: “After becoming a certain Mr., you will undoubtedly have your own jurisdiction and a large number of subordinates.
target: “Postquam aliquis Dominus fies, indubitanter suam iurisdictionem et multos subditos habebis.

source: They are fanatical and will completely follow the orders of a deity’s oracle like you.
target: Illi fanatici sunt et prorsus praecepta oraculi dei, sicut tui, sequerentur.

source: With some training, they can fulfill the requirements of the ritual.
target: Aliqua disciplina, requisita ritualis explere possunt.

source: What you need to worry about is how to increase their strength and tacit understanding to make the ritual more effective.”
target: Quod tibi sollicitudinem efficit, est quomodo vires eorum et tacitam intelligentiam augere possis, ut ritualis effectus efficacior fiat.

source: Wh— The original plan was for me to become an Oracle after digesting the Reaper potion, allowing me to establish a team to complete the ritual as quickly as possible.
target: Heu— Ordinatio originalis erat ut Oraculus post digestionem potionis Reaper fiam, quae mihi licebat turmam constituere ad ritualem quam celerrime peragendam.

source: How can I carry out this ritual now?
target: Quomodo nunc hoc rituale peragere possum?

source: Franca and the others are without a problem, but there are too few of them…
target: Franca et ceteri non sunt problema, sed eorum numerus nimis paucus est…

source: Lumian couldn’t help but frown.
target: Lumian non potuit quin fronem contraherere.

source: Upon seeing this, Madam Magician chuckled and said, “The Church of Knowledge, well-versed in the Hunter path, offered an alternative.”
target: Videns hoc, Magistra Magica risit et dixit: “Ecclesia Scientiae, in via Venatoris bene perita, alternativam oblationem proposuit.

source: “Of course, the prerequisite is that you can tame Ludwig.
target: “Scilicet, praerequisitum est ut Ludwig domare possis.

source: Angels can offset most quantity requirements.”
target: Angeli plurima requisita quantitatis compensare possunt.

source: “Angel level?” Lumian finally obtained information about Ludwig’s power from Madam Magician.
target: “Gradus Angelorum?” Tandem Lumian de potentia Ludwig a Magistra Magica notitiam accepit.

source: “Yes.” Madam Magician didn’t elaborate further.
target: “Ita.” Magistra Magica ulterius non explicavit.

source: Taming Ludwig? All I can do now is “bribe” him and give simple commands…
target: Ludwig domare? Nihil aliud nunc possum nisi eum “corrumpere” et simplicia mandata dare…

source: Lumian fell deep into thought.
target: Lumian in altum cogitationem incidit.

source: Madam Magician glanced at him and said, “You can wait until you digest the Reaper potion and visit the City of Exiles, Morora, before deciding which method to use to meet the ritual’s requirements.”
target: Magistra Magica eum aspexit et dixit: “Potes exspectare donec potionem Reaper digesturus sis et urbem Exulorum, Mororam, viseres, antequam decernas quo modo requisitis ritualis satisfaciaris.”

source: “Right, let’s discuss the vortex details through letters.”
target: “Recte, per litteras de subtilitatibus vorticis colloquamur.”

source: Lumian nodded and watched as Madam Magician vanished into thin air.
target: Lumian annuit et spectavit, dum Magistra Magica in aether evanuit.

source: Gazing at the gradually expanding dark border, he closed his eyes and recalled everything he had seen and heard that day.
target: Intuens limen obscurum paulatim dilatantem, oculos clausit et omnia illa die visa et audita recordatus est.

source: Unbeknownst to him, he clenched his fists tightly, and blazing white flames surged from his fists, burning fiercely.
target: Nescientes illi, manus arcte coarctavit, et flammas albas ardentes ex manibus eius effulserunt, vehementer urentes.

source: Jenna sat in an armchair in the living room, quietly waiting for Lumian to open the door and leave.
target: Jenna in sella bracchiali in conclavi sedeat, quiete exspectans ut Lumian ianuam aperiret et discederet.

source: The sound of gnawing and chewing echoed from the dining room.
target: Sonus manducandi et masticandi ex triclinio resonabat.

source: Lumian carried the unfinished bottle of absinthe to the balcony, settled into a chair, and took a sip.
target: Lumian vas absinthii imperfectum ad balconem portavit, in sella consedit, et sorbuit.

source: Jenna approached him with light footsteps and observed him for a few seconds.
target: Jenna levibus passibus ad eum accessit et eum per paucos secundos observavit.

source: “You’re in better shape.”
target: “Melius habitus es.”

source: “You can tell that too?” Lumian asked nonchalantly without turning his head.
target: “Id quoque potes dicere?” inquit Lumian leviter, caput non vertens.

source: Jenna pulled up a chair and sat down, sneering.
target: Jenna sellam arripuit et consedit, irridens.

source: “Your silent and reserved demeanor makes me feel more at ease than your previously excited and talkative demeanor.”
target: “Tua silentiosa et reticens indoles me facit magis tranquille sentire quam tua antea excitata et loquax indoles.”

source: Lumian gazed at the night outside the balcony and remained silent for a long time.
target: Lumian noctem extra balconem intuens diu tacitus mansit.

source: Jenna didn’t ask any questions either.
target: Jenna quoque nullas quaestiones fecit.

source: Suddenly, Lumian spoke in a deep voice, “I saw that lizard-like elf.”
target: Subito, Lumian voce profunda dixit: “Vidi illum elfum, quasi lacertam similem.

source: Jenna had heard him talk about Cordu and understood what it meant.
target: Jenna eum de Cordu loqui audiverat et intellexit quid id significaret.

source: She said in surprise, “Didn’t you go to the Aurora Order to meet Mr. K?
target: In admiratione dixit: “Nonne ad Ordinem Aurorae ivisti ut Dominum K convenires?

source: Why… Is that lizard-like elf related to the Aurora Order?”
target: Cur… Num ille elfus, qui ad lacertam similis est, ad Ordinem Aurorae pertinet?

source: “It stems from the one they believe in,” Lumian’s voice seemed to emerge from the depths of darkness.
target: “Ex illo procedit, in quem credunt,” videbatur vox Lumiani emergere ex profundis tenebris.

source: “No wonder…” Jenna suddenly understood Lumian’s previous state.
target: “Non mirum…” Jenna subito intellexit praecedens statum Lumiani.

source: “Madam Judgment mentioned that the one the Aurora Order believes in is close to Mr. Fool in power…”
target: “Magistra Iudicium commemoravit quod ille, in quem Ordinis Aurorae credunt, potentia prope Dominum Stultum sit…

source: It wasn’t something mortals could face directly, let alone exact revenge on!
target: Hoc non erat quod mortales directe oppugnare possent, nedum ulciscendi causa!

source: After a brief silence, Jenna understood and said, “Did you just meet Madam Magician?”
target: Post brevem silentium, Jenna intellexit et dixit: “Num modo Magistram Magicam convenisti?”

source: “You’ve grown quite smart after drinking the Witch potion,” Lumian turned to Jenna.
target: “Postquam potionem Veneficae bibi, valde callidus factus es,” Lumian ad Jenna convertit.

source: Jenna couldn’t help but ask, “Can’t Hunters speak nicely?”
target: Jenna non potuit quin quaereret: “Num Venatores non possunt bene loqui?”

source: She paused for a moment before adding, “What did Madam Magician say?”
target: Paulisper cessavit, deinde addens: “Quid dixit Magistra Magica?”

source: “She said to endure it for now and wait for Mr. Fool to wake up before considering what to do next,” Lumian replied simply.
target: “Dixit quod id pro tempore sustineres et Dominum Stultum evigilare exspectares, antequam consilium pro sequentibus cepisses,” Lumian simpliciter respondit.

source: Jenna tersely acknowledged, momentarily at a loss for words.
target: Jenna breviter annuit, momentum verbis caret.

source: After a moment, she stood up and went to Ludwig’s side in the dining room to retrieve a glass from the balcony.
target: Post momentum, surrexit et ad latus Ludwig in triclinio ivit ut calicem ex balcone tuleret.

source: She snatched the bottle of absinthe from Lumian’s hand and poured a third of it for herself.
target: Absinthii lagena e manu Lumiani rapuit et tertiam eius partem sibi effudit.

source: Jenna had just taken a sip of the dreamy green liquid when her face instinctively furrowed.
target: Mox, postquam Jenna sorbetum de liquore viridi somniorum simile biberat, vultus eius statim rugosus factus est.

source: “Heck, why do you people like to drink absinthe?
target: “Heu, cur vos absinthium bibere amatis?

source: It tastes awful!”
target: Sapidum horrendum est!

source: As a former Showy Diva, Jenna had drunk plenty of alcohol, but she still couldn’t accept the taste of absinthe.
target: Ut olim Diva ostentatrix, Jenna multum alcoholis bibeerat, sed saporem absinthii adhuc accipere non potuit.

source: Lumian scoffed but didn’t offer an explanation.
target: Lumian irridens respondit sed explanationem non tulit.

source: Jenna casually chatted, “I once read a book about a writer whose name I can’t remember.
target: Jenna leve colloquebatur: “Olim librum legi de scriptore cuius nomen mihi recordari non potest.

source: He said that those who enjoy absinthe either use it to pretend they are experienced or use it to reminisce about their experiences…”
target: Dixit eos qui absinthium amant, aut id ut se peritos simularent, aut id ad memoriam suarum experientiarum adhibere.

source: Lumian listened quietly, picked up the bottle, and took another mouthful.
target: Lumian quiete auscultavit, lagena rapuit, et alium sorbetum sumpsit.

source: The slightly burning alcohol slid down his throat, leaving behind a familiar bitterness.
target: Alcohol leviter ardens per fauces eius labebat, relinquens post se amaritudinem notam.
